Welcome to Hotel Ella's Edge

A quiet mountain retreat, perched above the valley

Just above Ella town and a short walk from the railway station, Hotel Ella's Edge is an intimate, family-run hideaway on the rim of Ella Gap. Every room opens to mountain views, with a private balcony to catch the sunrise over Ella Rock.

Wake to a complimentary breakfast on the open-air terrace, spend your day among Ella's tea hills, waterfalls and trails, and return to warm Sri Lankan hospitality and a home-cooked dinner.

Ella's Edge restaurant

Breakfast in the clouds

Every stay begins with a complimentary breakfast on the open-air terrace as the mist lifts off the valley — continental, Asian or à la carte. Come evening, the chefs cook authentic Sri Lankan rice and curry alongside Chinese, Indian, seafood and international dishes.

“Chef Charith was incredible — his Sri Lankan cooking was one of the best I’ve experienced.”Jagath · Sri Lanka
